explanation: Murasaki Shikibu, a lady at Japan's imperial court, wrote Genji about six centuries before Cervantes. Each book is often called the first novel, in different senses.

claims.text: The Tale of Genji was written by Murasaki Shikibu in the early 11th century, around 1010.
Part One of Don Quixote was published in 1605.
Murasaki Shikibu was a lady-in-waiting at the Japanese imperial court.
The Tale of Genji is often called the world's first novel, and Don Quixote the first modern novel.
The Tale of Genji predates Don Quixote by about six centuries.
